newsitem.title: FRANCE: Egypt, Iran seen wheat buyers soon.
newsitem.headline: Egypt, Iran seen wheat buyers soon.

text.p: Egypt and Iran are expected back in the world grain market soon to buy wheat for May and June but neither has yet said officially what its needs will be, European exporters said on Wednesday.
Pending tender announcements, however, most exporters said they saw scope for sales of approximately 200,000 tonnes to Iran and 200,000 to 300,000 tonnes to Egypt.
"Iran wants to cover for May and June. It is scouting around for wheat but so far we have nothing official," a trader said.
As far as Egypt is concerned, traders said they had no doubt it would be seen in the world market soon, most probably for wheat from the United States.
